claims.claim_text: The BESMILE-HF program was feasible in this 18-participant pilot: adherence was good, intervention participants completed required home exercises, and no intervention-related adverse events were captured.

claims.claim_text: After six weeks, self-efficacy improved more in the BESMILE-HF group than control, with a mean difference of 3.2 (95% CI 0.6 to 5.9; p=0.004).

claims.claim_text: BESMILE-HF produces a demonstrated clinical exercise-capacity benefit in chronic heart-failure patients.
